title: RestOREd
description: A Programmer Art addon to change the shape of ores to their Caves And Cliffs versions with the original palette.
body:
A simple Programmer Art add-on that changes the shape of certain ores to the unique ones added in Caves and Cliffs, but keeps the color palette and style of the originals.

![Screenshot of the inside of a cave with the new textures for Iron, Coal, and Gold ores. Torches are scattered.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/QoRZ8wlK/images/95a5dba633e9414b14d76f930ec77afbf7ab7b5d.png)

I made this mod for a personal collection of mods. If there's any specific mods that you want to be supported though, reach out to me on Bluesky at [@melo0611.bsky.social](https://melo0611.bsky.social/) with the mod suggestion and I can try to make it work.

### Mods Supported
**Tinker's Antique**
- Copper Ore
- Aluminum Ore (based off of Zinc Ore from Create)

More may come soon.

I edit these textures in Aseprite.
